body.statement: In the published two-arm finite-population problem, for every finite \(L<U\), the unrestricted minimax squared-error risk over schedules in \([L,U]^{2n}\) is exactly \((U-L)^2\) times the binary minimax risk, and a conditional Bernoulliization of the binary minimax rule attains that value.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the corresponding Theorem 2.3 environment in the arXiv source.
